title: Differentiable Structure Learning for Cyclic Linear Gaussian Models with Latent Confounders
abstract: arXiv:2609.38618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study causal structure learning from observational data in linear Gaussian structural causal models in the presence of directed cycles and an unknown number of exogenous latent confounders, bounded by a given maximum. We derive the covariance of the observed variables and introduce marginal quasi-equivalence, which characterizes when different causal models share a full-dimensional subset of the observational distributions they can generate. We formulate structure learning as minimization of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood with a logarithmically scaled complexity penalty that counts directed edges and latent variables. For a fixed number of observed variables and a fixed upper bound on latent variables, we establish consistency of global score minimizers up to marginal quasi-equivalence under algebraic faithfulness, structural minimality, and model-overlap assumptions. translated_title: 带潜在混杂因子的循环线性高斯模型的可微结构学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在存在有向环以及数量未知（不超过给定上界）的外生潜在混杂因子的情况下，如何从观测数据中对线性高斯结构因果模型进行因果结构学习。我们推导了观测变量的协方差，并提出了“边际拟等价”的概念，用以刻画不同的因果模型在何时共享其所能生成的观测分布中的一个满维子集。我们将结构学习问题表述为高斯负对数似然的最小化，并附加一个按对数尺度缩放的复杂度惩罚项，该惩罚项对有向边和潜在变量的数量进行计数。在固定的观测变量数量和固定的潜在变量上界条件下，我们在代数忠实性、结构最小性和模型重叠假设下，证明了全局得分最小化解在边际拟等价意义下的一致性。我们对有向边和候选潜在变量的引入进行参数化……
tldr: 本文针对同时含有有向环和潜在混杂因子的线性高斯结构因果模型，提出了一种基于似然最小化加对数复杂度惩罚的可微结构学习方法，并证明了全局最优解在“边际拟等价”意义下的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differentiable structure learning method for linear Gaussian SCMs with both directed cycles and latent confounders, based on likelihood minimization with a logarithmic complexity penalty, and proves consistency of the global optimum up to marginal quasi-equivalence.
